note: Expected outcomes are design assertions, not measured results; each case needs complete input fixtures and evidence before a test can be marked executed.

tests.name: same-subnet
tests.precondition: Complete lab model with two interfaces in the same broadcast domain

tests.name: routed-forward-return
tests.precondition: Complete model with connected and static routes in both directions

tests.name: missing-return-route
tests.precondition: Remove DB return route from a declared-complete route table; no alternate route exists

tests.name: restored-return-route
tests.precondition: Restore the exact route removed in T03

tests.name: policy-deny-expected
tests.precondition: Supported explicit deny matches required blocked flow; no alternate accepted path

tests.name: policy-missing
tests.precondition: A policy-dependent hop exists but policy data was not collected

tests.name: unsupported-nat
tests.precondition: Analysis path crosses a NAT feature not modeled by the selected engine

tests.name: view-only-move
tests.precondition: Move visual coordinates only; T02 semantics and result must not change

tests.name: serialization-roundtrip
tests.precondition: Export/import T02 preserves semantic model and deterministic result

tests.name: trunk-vlan-missing
tests.precondition: Supported VLAN model removes required VLAN from only available trunk; all relevant data complete

tests.name: migration-endpoint-rebinding
tests.precondition: Evaluate same workload intent with changed DB address and complete supported AWS path model

tests.name: migration-policy-not-collected
tests.precondition: DB moved to AWS but target/source policy evidence remains incomplete
